headline: The window buttons are back — and Manage Users reaches any browser
highlights: Close, minimize and zoom are visible again on macOS 26 — the window surface was painting over them
Admins can manage people from any browser at the usage endpoint's /manage page; the Mac's Manage Users folds those edits in instead of overwriting them
Only one Toolbox runs at a time, and a self-update now refreshes a duplicate install instead of leaving it behind
